name: ANSI/IEEE Star-zigzag transformer form
summary: IEEE-library form of star-zigzag transformer: a star-zigzag transformer combines a star-connected winding set with a zigzag-connected set.
description: This reference locates star-zigzag transformer in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. A star-zigzag transformer combines a star-connected winding set with a zigzag-connected set. Its winding arrangement and neutral duties require the manufacturer's complete connection designation. The public library uses HXF1T12 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

Read the zigzag terminal arrangement from the selected transformer diagram. A zigzag connection is not another spelling of a simple star winding. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
